scope: Combined model/effort editing, Role Activity default and profile instance management
implementation: One model/effort editor using binding-specific supportedReasoning; choosing another binding resets effort
Default tabs Activity/Profile; instance list and existing controls under Profile
Read-only Role activity aggregation using existing agent.trajectory.list and per-member room/participant filtering
Native LogItem and timeline recipe declarations extracted exactly; no upstream agent store/socket
Native PickerTriggerButton filters by readable frozen instance name

browserBehavior: switch to high-only model resets effort
switch to no-effort model disables selector

limits: Aggregate is recent diagnostic activity, not all historical records; select individual instance for older pages
Timeline colors do not establish live presence or task completion
Other application pages still include structural ports; not whole-site dependency conversion
